description: Ordered task sequences for primary continuous workflow simulation. Sequences reset before the session, feed model-facing task prompts one at a time, and preserve repository/tool/agent state between tasks.

persist_between_tasks: memory/state stores enabled by the active profile

sequences.reset_policy: Reset once before the session; preserve repository, tool, index, cache, generated config, memory, and agent state between tasks.
sequences.conversion_note: Executable shared-snapshot workflow: all five Terraform task regressions apply to commit e02391ad384c9c38f1d7f40b853c0d2297348094 and can run in one persistent session without repository reset between tasks.
sequences.seed_patch_policy: All five task seed-regression.patch files are compatible with this shared snapshot as standalone task seeds and as an ordered persistent workflow seed stack.

sequences.seed_patch_policy: All five task seed-regression.patch files are controlled regressions with at least five changed production files per task. sequences.complexity_note: Complexity upgraded 2026-07-08: each task now uses multi-edit seeded regressions across paired OrchardCore infrastructure/resource/email/sanitization behaviors, with broader xUnit class verifiers and standalone seeded-fail/fixed-pass gates.
sequences.complexity_bar: Each task seed patch touches at least five production files; standalone seeded-fail/fixed-pass gates and workflow prepare-only passed after stack-safe allocation.
